research_question: Does the unchanged minimal target-state replay treatment continue to avoid a paired Official success regression while producing replay-conditioned repair on the next fixed development cases?
claim_scope: Development mechanism scaling after qualification. This batch cannot support held-out generalization, leaderboard, effect-size, or SOTA claims.

selection.rationale: Continue the pre-existing randomized case order immediately after qualification positions 9-12; do not replace cases based on difficulty, historical behavior, or either arm's outcome.

treatment.A-F: One continuous free Agent session with ordinary execution feedback and the shared minimal evaluator-integrity boundary.
treatment.B-FCsR: The identical Agent interface plus repeatedly callable whole-program replay from the target initial state, with raw counterexamples returned to the same session and final delivery restricted to a replay-passed program.

shared_execution.source_cache_policy: Reuse only an exact-revision source cache across arms. Do not transfer a candidate program, construction package cache, trajectory, replay artifact, or evaluator result.
shared_execution.package_cache_policy: Each construction episode has a private package cache; every B replay uses the target image's default empty package cache.
shared_execution.parallelism: At most two episodes concurrently. Each pair runs sequentially in A-then-B order on one lane.

outcomes.paired: Report the complete 2x2 paired outcome table; do not infer missing outcomes from generation or diagnostics.
outcomes.failure: Assign the earliest decisive Observation, Constraint, or Operation layer with evidence; infrastructure is separate.

decision_rules: Complete all eight episodes unless an external infrastructure event makes one ineligible; never replace a case because of an observed outcome.
A candidate-formation failure is an algorithm outcome, not infrastructure censoring.
Any retry or replacement must be specified before it executes and must be accompanied by an analysis excluding the affected pair when researcher action contributed.

Retain the minimal treatment for broader development evaluation only if paired Official success is not lower and at least one independent case shows feedback-conditioned repair or a treatment-only Official pass.
A success tie with replay serving only as first-pass certification is insufficient to claim effectiveness.
Resource reduction cannot compensate for lower Official success, and resource claims require unconditional reporting.
Do not modify the algorithm from this batch alone; aggregate it with the prior qualification and failure corpus before proposing the next algorithmic change.
